findings: The 48-hour preparation exhausted ten iterations at the unchanged 2 micrometre position and 3e-9 m/s velocity limits; it was not killed by time or memory limits.

Position corrections initially contracted from 0.3694 m to 30.44 micrometres, then fluctuated between 6.448 and 31.15 micrometres. The final change was 20.707 micrometres and 2.308e-8 m/s, dominated by along-track change.

Every saved 48-hour propagation XML omits orbitPocDerivativeProfile and therefore selects legacy_v3. Corrected synthetic reference and force residual arithmetic and the coupled mean solver are opt-in and were bypassed.
The completed 24-hour prefix used a separately initialized state and is a preparation regression comparison, not an identical physical initial-state comparison.
limitations: The arithmetic operation responsible for the numerical floor has not been isolated by an identical-input native perturbation experiment.
Selecting the already-corrected staged path is a targeted diagnostic hypothesis, not a demonstrated fix.
No objective-fit, covariance, benchmark completion or release claim is supported.
Prior generator and 24-hour checkpoint metadata were verified; their full output inventories were not rehashed during this focused diagnostic.
scope: Independent read-only failure attribution, trajectory postprocessing and source-path review. No source edits, native workloads, threshold changes or failed-case replacement.
